title: Every stynx HTTP endpoint must be either role-bound or explicitly public
statement: Every implemented HTTP endpoint MUST either have a non-empty permission or role binding, carry an explicit public marker, or match the documented bootstrap and development allow-list in docs/framework/arch/invariants/RBAC-001-allowlist.json. The default policy is deny: an endpoint with no binding, no public marker, and no allow-list entry is release-gating.
rationale: The reference authentication endpoints are intentionally public or development-only. All other unbound endpoints block release so that missing authorization can never become an implicit grant.
